prompt: Given the collection of intervals `intervals = [[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]]`, all overlapping intervals are merged together. How many non-overlapping intervals remain after merging?
explanation: Sorting by start times and collapsing overlapping ranges gives [[1, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]], which contains exactly 3 non-overlapping interval(s).
